# tenzir_people (Data Source)

The members of an organization and their roles. Needs `Organization.listPeople`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tenzir_people" "acme" {
  organization_id = data.tenzir_organization.acme.id
}

output "admins" {
  value = [for p in data.tenzir_people.acme.people : p.email if contains(p.role_ids, "org.admin")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID or slug of the organization.

### Read-Only

- `people` (Attributes List) The members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--people))

<a id="nestedatt--people"></a>
### Nested Schema for `people`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The email address, if known.
- `name` (String) The name, if known.
- `role_ids` (List of String) The IDs of the assigned roles.
- `user_id` (String) The user ID.
